problem.title: Most hospital software was built for billing. Yours should be built for care.
problem.subtitle: Indian hospitals run on systems designed twenty years ago as billing terminals with a patient file bolted on. AarogyaEHR starts from the clinical workflow — and billing, compliance, and analytics fall out of it correctly.
problem.billingFirstDesc: Legacy HIMS started as billing terminals with patient records bolted on. Clinical workflows are an afterthought.
problem.doctorsFightDesc: Generic forms slow down consultations. Nurses keep paper backups because the system doesn't match ward reality.
problem.revenueLeakageDesc: Promoters discover missed charges, unbilled procedures, and TPA rejections only when it's too late to fix.

specialtyGrid.title: Your specialty isn't a dropdown option here.
specialtyGrid.subtitle: Each specialty has its own templates, order sets, registries, and safety logic — built with practicing clinicians, for Indian volumes.
specialtyGrid.obgTagline: Not a generic form with 'Gynaecology' written on top.
specialtyGrid.obgFeature2: ANC visit tracker with risk scoring
specialtyGrid.nephroTagline: Dialysis workflows built for Indian unit economics.
specialtyGrid.oncoTagline: Chemo daycare where throughput meets safety.

indiaNative.title: ABDM, ABHA, GST, TPA, NABH — built in, not bolted on.
indiaNative.subtitle: Every compliance requirement and Indian healthcare workflow is native to the system, not a third-party integration.
indiaNative.abdmDesc: Create and verify ABHA at registration. Push records to the patient's PHR with consent. Full Milestone-3 compliance.
indiaNative.languagesDesc: Patient-facing screens, prints, and consent forms in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Kannada, Malayalam, Gujarati, Punjabi, and Odia.
indiaNative.gstDesc: Bill in lakh-crore format with automatic GST breakup. Generate e-invoices and file-ready reports.
indiaNative.tpaDesc: Track every TPA query from submission to settlement. Pre-auth workflows and rejection analytics.
indiaNative.nabhDesc: Export NABH 6th edition audit trails in one click. Continuous readiness, not last-minute scrambles.
indiaNative.dpdpDesc: Built-in consent management, data access controls, and audit logs for Digital Personal Data Protection Act.

worksEverywhere.title: Tested on the oldest PC at your nursing station.
worksEverywhere.subtitle: AarogyaEHR is built for the infrastructure Indian hospitals actually have, not the infrastructure vendors wish they had.
worksEverywhere.screenDesc: Designed for the screens actually in Indian hospitals — not just the latest MacBook.
worksEverywhere.speedDesc: Optimized for hospital broadband. No heavy animations or bloated bundles.
worksEverywhere.offlineDesc: Data entry continues when the network drops. Syncs automatically when connection returns.
worksEverywhere.sharedDesc: Built for nursing stations where multiple staff share one PC. Fast user switching, session isolation.

clinicalSafety.title: Designed so the critical value is never missed.
clinicalSafety.subtitle: Safety isn't a feature — it's the foundation. Every design decision prioritizes clinical correctness over aesthetics.
clinicalSafety.allergyDesc: Patient allergies are always visible at the top of every screen. Never collapses, never hides.
clinicalSafety.alertDesc: Red is reserved for genuine danger. Graduated severity prevents alert fatigue.
clinicalSafety.colorDesc: Every status is communicated by color + icon + text. Safe for color-blind staff.
clinicalSafety.monitorDesc: Tested on washed-out hospital monitors. Critical information stays readable.

testimonials.title: Hospitals that made the switch
testimonials.testimonial1Quote: We moved 11 OPDs and 240 beds off paper in 6 weeks. Discharge time dropped from 5 hours to 90 minutes.
testimonials.testimonial2Quote: The dialysis module finally matches how we actually run our unit. Slot scheduling and package billing just work.
testimonials.testimonial3Quote: Our nurses stopped keeping shadow paper records. That's when I knew the system actually worked.

pricing.title: Pricing that scales like your hospital does.
pricing.subtitle: Per-doctor for clinics. Per-bed for hospitals. ABDM, security, and Indian-language support included in every plan — never sold as add-ons.
pricing.alwaysIncludedSubtitle: Every plan, every customer — no upsells for compliance or safety.
pricing.heroTitle: Start at ₹1 per patient. Scale as you grow.
pricing.heroSubtitle: Simple per-patient pricing based on your specialties. Higher complexity, slightly higher rate. ABDM, security, and 9 Indian languages included — never sold as add-ons. GST @18% as per Indian regulations.
pricing.calcSubtitle: Select your specialties and patient volume to get an instant estimate.
pricing.calcDescription: Our pricing is ₹1 per patient base with specialty multipliers from 1x to 3x based on clinical complexity. Higher volume? Get automatic discounts.
pricing.calcFeeNote: One-time onboarding fee includes setup, training & go-live support. 18% GST on all charges. Volume discounts: 5% over 5K patients, 10% over 15K, 15% over 30K.
pricing.faqA1: Yes, one-time onboarding fee covers setup, data migration, configuration, and on-site training. GST @18% applies.
pricing.faqQ2: Do you charge for ABDM compliance?
pricing.faqA2: No. Compliance is a baseline, not an upsell.
pricing.faqQ3: Can we start with OPD and add IPD later?
pricing.faqA3: Yes — plans upgrade in place, data carries over.
pricing.faqA4: Available on Enterprise for hospitals with data-residency policies; we recommend our India-region cloud for most.
pricing.faqA5: Annual billing default with 2 months free; monthly option available. Volume discounts for high-patient-volume facilities.
pricing.faqA6: Base rate is ₹1/patient. Specialty multipliers apply based on complexity (1x for General Medicine up to 3x for Critical Care). 18% GST added as per Indian tax regulations.
pricing.ctaTitle: See AarogyaEHR configured for your facility.
